source: Rutgers bus route/stop geometry snapshot (2026-09-26), derived from Passio data via the open-source RUBus project (github.com/JoyousJohn/rubus-public). Static by design: Rutgers moved live tracking to TripShot in July 2026 and no public routes API exists. Refresh by re-exporting from RUBus lib/routes + lib/stops.js.
